tools.name: list_earnings
tools.description: Earnings events in a date window (max 120 days), filtered by status, cap_bucket (small, mid, large, mega), timing (BMO, AMC) or one of the caller's watchlists (name or id; see list_watchlists). Relay each event's status, cite source_url for confirmed dates, label estimates as projections. as_of repl

tools.name: get_date_changes
tools.description: Earnings dates that moved, were confirmed, went into conflict or were reported since an ISO timestamp, with old and new date and status and the source_url behind each; cite it. Filters: ticker, cap_bucket, watchlist. Oldest first; when has_more is true, call again with since = next_since.

tools.name: get_earnings_history
tools.description: Past earnings release dates for one ticker: weekday, BMO/AMC timing, days after quarter end, and the EDGAR filing behind each (source_url). Use it to judge how regular the company's cadence is.

tools.name: get_data_coverage
tools.description: How far back data goes for one ticker: release count, first and last release, a count per year, whether releases rest on 8-K Item 2.02 or 10-Q/10-K filings, and when tracking began. Use it before asking for long histories.

tools.name: get_earnings_results
tools.description: Earnings releases for one ticker: revenue and EPS (GAAP and non-GAAP) read by software from the press release, each with its sentence; guidance sentences; call time; exhibit URL. tools.name: get_guidance
tools.description: Guidance statements for one ticker by release, newest first (beta): the verbatim sentence and the exhibit URL. metric, low, high and period_guided are filled only when the sentence states metric, scale and period, otherwise null with a reason. Quote the sentence, cite the exhibit, verify any number

tools.name: get_fundamentals

tools.name: get_filings

tools.name: search_filings
tools.description: Ranked full-text search over sections extracted from 10-K and 10-Q filings (mda, risk_factors, results_of_operations, liquidity). tools.name: get_filing_sections

tools.name: list_watchlists
tools.description: The caller's watchlists with their tickers. Watchlists belong to the account behind the API key; pass a list's name (or id) as the `watchlist` argument of list_earnings or get_date_changes to answer questions like 'what on my list reports this week'.

tools.name: set_watchlist
tools.description: Create the named watchlist, or replace its tickers if it exists. Tickers outside the covered universe are kept and reported in `unknown`. Free accounts: 1 list of 25 tickers; paid plans: 5 lists of 500.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "get_next_earnings" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_next_earnings" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
